assessment.summary: The website presents a credible local business with clear contact paths, but mobile performance and homepage messaging can be strengthened.

executiveSummary: The website presents a credible local business with clear contact paths, but mobile performance and homepage messaging can be strengthened.

strengths.title: Clear contact information
strengths.description: The crawl found a dedicated contact page and visible phone number on the homepage.

issues.title: Mobile performance is below a comfortable threshold
issues.recommendation: Optimize hero imagery and defer non-critical scripts on the homepage.

limitations: Visual interpretation of screenshot contrast is subjective.

homepageChanges.summary: The homepage communicates a local service business, but visitors need a clearer offer statement, stronger primary CTA, and faster mobile loading before they can confidently take the next step.

priorityChanges.title: Clarify the hero headline with the service and service area
priorityChanges.problem: The homepage headline does not immediately state what service the company provides or where it operates.
priorityChanges.recommendation: Rewrite the hero headline so visitors immediately understand what service the company provides and where it operates.
priorityChanges.expectedImpact: Visitors can decide within seconds whether the business is relevant to their need.

priorityChanges.title: Make the primary homepage CTA more specific
priorityChanges.problem: The main call-to-action uses generic language that does not communicate the next step.
priorityChanges.recommendation: Replace the primary CTA with a specific action such as Request a Quote or Book an Appointment, and keep it visible above the fold on mobile.
priorityChanges.expectedImpact: More visitors understand how to start a conversation and take action.

priorityChanges.title: Improve mobile homepage load performance
priorityChanges.problem: PageSpeed mobile performance is below a comfortable threshold for first impressions.
priorityChanges.recommendation: Optimize hero imagery and defer non-critical scripts that delay the mobile homepage experience.
priorityChanges.expectedImpact: Faster first paint and lower bounce risk on mobile visits.
